text: {"fixed_clause": "For the purpose of enhancing user experience and delivering tailored promotional campaigns, subject to the recipient's prior consent and a clear mechanism to stop receiving them, our platform processes sensitive categories of information including religious beliefs, ethnic origin, and comprehensive health records, granting full access to all operational departments and commercial partners for targeted advertising initiatives."}

data.fixed_clause: For the purpose of enhancing user experience and delivering tailored promotional campaigns, subject to the recipient's prior consent and a clear mechanism to stop receiving them, our platform processes sensitive categories of information including religious beliefs, ethnic origin, and comprehensive health records, granting full access to all operational departments and commercial partners for targeted advertising initiatives.
